reviews.title: RIP OFF APP
reviews.text: The APP does not clearly indicate you will be charged $5.99 until an unintended charge processes from a click. Then after you immediately notify them via email, there is no response. So Im charged for an App for a month that Im not going to use.

reviews.title: App crashes
reviews.text: This app keeps crashing and tutorials won’t play. It’s not worth the $5.99 a week.

reviews.title: Subscription now!!!?
reviews.text: I’m OUT! Just ridiculous. Paying to remove the watermark was one thing, now pay to even use the app at all. Greed! Good riddance!

reviews.title: Billing
reviews.text: Pls stop trying to bill me for something I deleted along time ago before I report the app.

reviews.title: Not worth any payment
reviews.text: This is a joke right -paying for this!!! Cmon make a free option.

One should not have to “subscribe” in order to use the 7 day free trial, you have no right to personal data (payment info) until a person decides to become a customer and enter into a business agreement either you. This is the quickest way for an app to get deleted …
